description: The router's NTP server, chrony: the addresses it answers on, whom it answers, and whether it serves its own clock when it follows no time server.

allow.description: Address ranges of the clients the time server answers; chrony ignores others, and the firewall accepts NTP from these alone.

listen.description: Addresses of the router in the default VRF on which it answers NTP, on UDP port 123; the firewall accepts NTP on them from `allow`. chrony itself answers on every address, so the firewall alone keeps the others closed.

x-chalkos-rules.description: The time server listens on unicast addresses.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the address " + self.filter(a, !cel.bind(x, ip(a), x != ip("0.0.0.0") && x != ip("::") && !cidr("127.0.0.0/8").contains(x) && x != ip("::1") && !cidr("169.254.0.0/16").contains(x) && !cidr("fe80::/10").contains(x) && !cidr("224.0.0.0/4").contains(x) && !cidr("ff00::/8").contains(x) && !cidr("::ffff:0:0/96").contains(x)))[0] + " is no unicast address the time server can listen on"
x-chalkos-rules.rule: self.all(a, cel.bind(x, ip(a), x != ip("0.0.0.0") && x != ip("::") && !cidr("127.0.0.0/8").contains(x) && x != ip("::1") && !cidr("169.254.0.0/16").contains(x) && !cidr("fe80::/10").contains(x) && !cidr("224.0.0.0/4").contains(x) && !cidr("ff00::/8").contains(x) && !cidr("::ffff:0:0/96").contains(x)))

localStratum.description: Stratum at which the router serves its own clock while it follows no time server, as chrony's `local stratum <n> orphan`: five minutes after chrony starts without a source, or once the estimated error of the source it followed passes a second, its clients take the router's clock, however far from the real time it is. Null answers as unsynchronised then, which clients refuse. Give a stratum above that of every server on the network, such as 10.

title: TimeServer

rules.description: A TimeServer listens on an address of a family its clients' ranges are of.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, !cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, ["ipv4", "ipv6"].exists(f, s.listen.exists(a, ip(a).family() == f) && s.allow.exists(p, cidr(p).ip(0).family() == f)))).map(n, "TimeServer " + n).join(", ") + " listens on no address of a family its clients' ranges are of, so it would answer no one; give listen and allow a family in common"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, ["ipv4", "ipv6"].exists(f, s.listen.exists(a, ip(a).family() == f) && s.allow.exists(p, cidr(p).ip(0).family() == f))))
